title: Hyundai expected to outsell Ford in third quarter as Detroit automakers lack hybrids
summary: Hyundai is projected to surpass Ford in sales during the third quarter of 2026, primarily due to Ford and General Motors' limited offerings in hybrid vehicles. Analysts from Cox have indicated that the absence of a diverse hybrid lineup is contributing to the sales decline for these Detroit automakers. This trend highlights the growing consumer preference for hybrid options, which Hyundai appears to be capitalizing on effectively.
